dedupe_keys.name: u s census bureau subnational population and housing tables with administrative boundaries international on hdx

description: The U.S. Census Bureau publishes, for individual countries, subnational population and housing tables linked to administrative boundary geodatabases on the Humanitarian Data Exchange; 25 of its 34 HDX datasets matched a search for housing on 2026-09-26. The boundaries are aligned to the U.S. Department of State Large Scale International Boundaries, and the tables are built from national censuses and surveys. The Syria set, for example, gives population for the 2004 census and estimates for 2011, 2014 and 2016 by age and sex, with housing, access to services, displacement and people in need, drawing on the 2004 census tables of building characteristics among other sources; the Saint Vincent and the Grenadines set, from the 2012 census, includes households and buildings, and the Iraq and Mali sets add migration and displacement. Coverage: one dataset per country for a set of countries. Access: a zipped file geodatabase and an Excel workbook per country, with a metadata tab. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: Census Bureau staff altered boundaries and modified statistics as recorded in each metadata tab, and reference years differ between countries. Simulation uses are subnational housing and population baselines for exposure and needs estimates where national statistics are hard to reach. Related records: the GAR15 exposure datasets.
